# Load resources

```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| message: false # removes tidyverse loader & here location for privacy
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tidymodels)

source(here("functions", "set_env-variables.R"))
source(file.path(PATH_FUNCTIONS, "load_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load best model config

selected_config <- load_selected_config(threshold = TRUE)
selected_wf <- load_selected_wf()
```

```{r}
#| label: load train dataset

train_df <- load_imputed_df(selected_config[["imp"]])
```

# Generate Resamples

```{r}
#| label: generate folds

# using new folds compared to thresholds just to avoid biases
fit_folds <- split_vfold(train_df, strata = "depression_phq4_binary_in_1y", v = 10, seed = 49)
```

# Fit on resamples for train metrics

```{r}
#| label: do resamples fit for best wf

resample_fit <- selected_wf %>%
  fit_resamples(fit_folds,
    control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
  )
```

# Final model fit on entire training data

```{r}
#| label: do full fit for best wf

final_fit <- selected_wf %>%
  fit(data = train_df)
```

# Export

```{r}
#| label: export models

save_model(resample_fit, type = "resample")
save_model(final_fit, type = "full")
```
